Resonance energies, neutron and gamma widths
were determined with SAMMY Ver.7.0.0 using Reich-Moor
formalism.
- The measured capture yield is normalized to the
Gressier's transmission data, and therefore it is
free from uncertainties due to sample mass detector
efficiency, and incident neutron flux.
- All resonances have been considered to be s-wave.
- The spin and parity of all resonances were taken
from JENDL-4.0.
- Doppler effect was modeled using the free gas model
with a temperature of 27 deg-C.
- Thermal cross section of 181 b was considered
instead of the value of 161 b found in the present
evaluations. The negative resonance parameters
describing the 1/v region have been chosen
accordingly: Eres=-1 eV, Ggamma=40.5 meV,
Gn=2.27 meV, Gf=0.441 ueV.
- The scattering radius R' was determined from the
analysis of transmission data in the region between
resonances from 12 to 35 eV, resulting in the values
- In a first iteration the average radiative width
below 43 eV was calculated as 40.9(18) meV and was
kept fixed for all resonances in the final fits.
